# Fact Representation

The Fact class models an identity-free representation of facts in the IR, which contains various attributes such as fact type, payload, and provenance information. This structure is crucial for maintaining the integrity of extracted information without embedding unique identifiers, thereby aligning with the specifications outlined in the two-layered architecture of the IR.
